Kill [[Baubao Wavewrath]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Baubao Wavewrath in [[the Undercity]].
* *BONUS* Kill Baubao Wavewrath in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
The shortest route would be to enter [[the Undercity]] from [[Vizunah Square (Local Quarter)]], if unlocked. There are plenty of [[Kappa (level 20)|Kappa]] surrounding Baubao who use [[Turtle Shell]], so plan accordingly.

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
;[[Zaishen Bounty]]
:''"Kill Baubao Wavewrath in the Undercity."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = This despicable villain still stalks the land, preying on the innocent. Heroes who are up to the challenge should seek this fiend out, taking blood as payment for a life of atrocious deeds.}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

== Notes ==
* Baubao will not spawn if [[When Kappa Attack]] is active.
* Consider completing this quest at the same time as the [[Chung, the Attuned (Zaishen quest)|Chung, the Attuned Zaishen quest]], since that quest is available from the Zaishen Bounty signpost on the third day after this quest (based on the [[Daily activities|Zaishen Bounty cycle]]) and both bosses are found in the Undercity.
* Sometimes Baubao's [[mob]] will [[aggro]] a mob of [[Am Fah]]s nearby, making the fight easier for you.
**Consider using this to your advantage as it only has to be [[attack]]ed by you once to be "killed" by you.
